title: GEM-KMeans: Memory-Efficient and Accurate Clustering on Massive Scale with GPU Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2609.36074v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Memory-efficient scaling on clustering problems without sacrificing statistical accuracy is of central interest for large-scale data analysis and machine learning problems. Nonnegative low-rank (NLR) matrix factorization for $K$-means is a scalable clustering method, which connects to semidefinite relaxations with optimal average-case exact recovery guarantees. However, a direct GPU implementation of NLR requires multiple large factor-sized buffers and substantial data movements that are essentially memory-bound. In this paper, we introduce GEM-KMeans, a spectrally normalized yet mathematically equivalent NLR formulation that fuses the gradient update, nonnegative projection, and sufficient statistics for normalization and iterate movement into a matrix-multiplication epilogue. translated_title: GEM-KMeans：基于GPU优化的大规模内存高效精确聚类方法
translated_abstract: 在不牺牲统计精度的情况下实现聚类问题的内存高效扩展，是大规模数据分析和机器学习问题的核心关注点。用于K均值的非负低秩（NLR）矩阵分解是一种可扩展的聚类方法，它与半定规划松弛相联系，并具有最优的平均情形精确恢复保证。然而，NLR的直接GPU实现需要多个因子大小的大型缓冲区以及大量数据移动，这在本质上受限于内存。在本文中，我们提出了GEM-KMeans，这是一种经过谱归一化但在数学上等价的NLR公式，它将梯度更新、非负投影以及用于归一化和迭代移动的充分统计量融合到矩阵乘法的后处理步骤中。我们的IO感知GPU实现不再保留三个巨大的因子大小数组，而是仅生成单个因子，并使用小的分块归约数组作为附加的…
tldr: GEM-KMeans提出了一种数学上等价的谱归一化非负低秩K均值公式，将梯度更新、非负投影和归一化所需的充分统计量融合进GPU矩阵乘法的后处理步骤，仅需保留单个因子数组，从而在保证统计精度的同时实现大规模聚类的高内存效率与高性能。
en_tdlr: GEM-KMeans introduces a mathematically equivalent spectrally normalized NLR formulation for K-means that fuses gradient updates, nonnegative projections, and normalization sufficient statistics into a GPU matrix-multiplication epilogue, retaining only a single factor array to achieve memory-efficient and accurate clustering at massive scale.
